title: pauseWithdraw bypasses the MINIMUM_STAKE / dust-forces-full-exit rule (INV-6 weakening); sub-minimum positions + dusted totalStaked (emission can floor to 0)
description: withdraw() enforces a dust guard (L346-351) that forces a full exit when the remaining position would fall below MINIMUM_STAKE, upholding INV-6. pauseWithdraw (L245-261) omits this guard, so during pause a user can leave a sub-MINIMUM_STAKE position and dust totalStaked. This makes the low-stake/low-APY dust regime reachable, where _updatePhUSDEmissionRate / per-share math can floor phUSD emission to 0 (under-emission, cf. L-13). The catastrophic accumulator-overflow facet originally hypothesized was REFUTED by symbolic analysis (out of realistic range).
impact: State-handling / invariant weakening. No theft. The reachable consequence is degraded precision / under-emission (emission flooring to 0 in the dust regime), a low-severity effect. INV-6 (which withdraw() enforces via MINIMUM_STAKE) is weakened by pauseWithdraw's missing guard.
attackPath: 1. Contract paused; user pauseWithdraw(amount) leaving 0 < remaining < MINIMUM_STAKE (no dust guard at L245-261).
2. totalStaked can be driven to dust while positions persist.

3. In the dust regime, _updatePhUSDEmissionRate / per-share math can floor emission to 0 (under-emission), weakening the first-depositor/precision mitigation INV-6 enforced elsewhere by MINIMUM_STAKE.
recommendation: Apply the same dust/MINIMUM_STAKE guard in pauseWithdraw that withdraw() uses (force full exit when remaining < MINIMUM_STAKE), so INV-6 holds on every exit path.
corroboratingSources: cross-ref L-13 (ledger): shared CONSEQUENCE (dust-regime emission-zeroing), distinct root cause

tier3Verification.detail: CONFIRMED (invariant weakening + emission-zeroing); REFUTED (overflow-DoS facet, out of realistic range).

borderlineFlag: None significant - clean Low (invariant weakening; overflow facet refuted, dust-emission consequence is low-impact). NOT suppressed under KI-2 (blesses MINIMUM_STAKE as a mitigation, not pauseWithdraw bypassing it) or KI-3 (dust handler lives on withdraw()).
